title: ABC-Belarus lost its hoster Autistici/Inventati because of American fascists
content: Back in 2010, at the height of the repression, one of our comrades contacted us and proposed setting up a website for our group. At the time, Italian activists from Autistici became our hosters. For a small annual donation, they handled the technical infrastructure, allowing us to focus on our work.
